archives.coverage_limitation: Each retained replay prefix stops 5.5–9.3 source hours after UTC midnight; every complete compressed daily archive is retained, but none of its rows has original receipt/availability and full-day replay was not performed.

required_missing_corpus.authorization_boundary: No probe, archive download, replay, or multi-day capture was launched by this inventory. A multi-day capture was not started without explicit authorization. Do not count authored fixtures, repeated records, stretched timestamps, or archive-download receipt as the required corpus.
required_missing_corpus.clocks: Preserve exchange source time in original payload and each local WebSocket receipt in CaptureRecord.received_ns; use that actual receipt as the declared local knowledge/availability clock. Do not substitute archive download/index receipt.
required_missing_corpus.coverage: Two concurrent synchronized OKX spot books receipt streams (BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT, books depth 400 per side) spanning the same 72 consecutive UTC hours, all six instrument-days, with at least 100000 unique admitted native market messages after market_data publication.
required_missing_corpus.elapsed_time_prerequisite: A fresh 72-hour UTC source window must actually elapse after both authorized collection streams start, followed by completion, replay/publication and verification. Historical OKX archives lack original per-record receipt/availability and cannot satisfy it.
required_missing_corpus.implementation_prerequisite: Reviewed baseline HEAD has a 10000-position BookInput/publication and archive-diagnostic limit. Shared in-progress worktree adds bounded BookStream v2 publication/query/replay up to 1000000 positions while preserving the legacy in-memory limit at 10000; parent owns validation. Separately, capture config remains one instrument per process with a hard 3600-second duration ceiling, and there is no 72-hour dual-stream segment rollover/handoff command. Current configs/live/okx-btc-usdt.json captures BTC only for 20 seconds; no OKX ETH capture config is checked in.
required_missing_corpus.source_access: OKX production public WebSocket wss://ws.okx.com:8443/ws/v5/public and channel books are public/no authentication in current official API documentation; route availability from this host remains unprobed.
required_missing_corpus.venues_and_products: OKX public spot books for BTC-USDT and ETH-USDT, depth 400 per side, channel=books.

capture_path.documented_finite_command: uv run --frozen --no-editable alpha-collect capture --config configs/live/okx-btc-usdt.json --output data/okx/live

capture_path.required_configurations: A separately provisioned finite OKX ETH-USDT books config and a BTC config set to duration_seconds at most 3600, with suitably justified max_messages/max_bytes inside hard limits; run both instruments over the same UTC window with ordered durable receipt journaling and explicit bounded segment continuation/gap accounting.
capture_path.available_public_access: Official OKX public WebSocket/books endpoint is documented as public/no-auth; this inventory did not probe host reachability.
capture_path.not_currently_supported: No current command provides one uninterrupted 72-hour capture or dual-stream rollover. Real collection requires 72 elapsed hours and a supervised capture process with recovery and exact receipt preservation; no unattended run was started.
capture_path.recording_layout: Use output root data/okx/live, whose collector writes immutable recording-id subdirectories containing request, manifest, raw payload and receipt journal. Preserve each capture segment and link adjacent segments through source-sequence and gap evidence; do not concatenate or deduplicate source records to manufacture continuity.

implementation.format: canonical-book-stream-v2 / book-dataset-v2; legacy v1 readable with unchanged v1 replay/query identities
implementation.bounds: One native observation and output batch in memory; max 1000000 selected positions per input; per-file byte caps, 16 MiB canonical line and 1 MiB header. Legacy in-memory admission and live BookCapture retain their independent 10000-position bound.
implementation.publication: Stream raw normalization and independently compare staged canonical records to fresh raw reconstruction before fsync and atomic visibility; two normalization passes instead of three eager passes.
implementation.session: Explicit complete admission once; reusable BookSnapshot session returns isolated codec-decoded metadata and rows, checks pinned file fingerprints and hashes observation descriptors before first yield. Stores and ancestors must remain protected. No repeated raw admission for warm queries.
implementation.query: open/batches is bounded; read convenience method still collects its result. Exact receipt/known-at eligibility, controls and immutable query identity preserved.
implementation.replay: One lookahead with exact phases/cursor validation. Equal-receipt groups spill to temporary SQLite with a 2 MiB page cache to preserve legacy epoch/position ordering without retaining a full tied history. Explicit close releases unfinished stream/spill state.
implementation.independent_checks: Authored exact Decimal expected levels, deletions, gap/cutoff/mutation and equal-receipt prior-epoch cases; every native prefix observation compared with independent raw traversal; retained v1 baseline traces and fresh process reopen exactly agree.
implementation.measurement_dependency: psutil 7.2.2 added only as direct development dependency; already resolved package version unchanged; isolated Feast and runtime package locks unchanged.
implementation.rollback: Revert code without removing evidence; v1 remains readable, v2 requires this newer reader. Old readers cannot consume v2.
